bearing.model.v1alpha1.UnmergeRecord.sch.description:
UnmergeRecord is one un-merge: aliases that left an active subject for
 another (docs/spec/data-model.md, "Un-merge"). A reactivated subject
 also has its merge record stamped with unmerged_at; a split mint has
 nothing else that says where it came from.

^(eventId)$.description: The event whose apply un-merged them.

^(mergeEventId)$.description:
For a reactivated subject, the event that had merged it into subject_id;
 empty for a split.

^(subjectId)$.description: The active subject the aliases left.

^(targetId)$.description: The subject they moved to: the one reactivated, or the split mint.

event_id.description: The event whose apply un-merged them.

merge_event_id.description:
For a reactivated subject, the event that had merged it into subject_id;
 empty for a split.

split.description: True when target_id was minted by this un-merge (rule split).

subject_id.description: The active subject the aliases left.

target_id.description: The subject they moved to: the one reactivated, or the split mint.
